SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   B. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

5. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   C. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   C. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.

7. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.

8. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   B. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

11. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Rights; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
